legacyUpgrade: Exact NSIS product identities and MSI upgrade GUIDs; /UPDATE preserves AppData
cursorValidation: Root cause corrected (default graphics profile back to Compatible) plus a native WM_SETCURSOR refresh while fullscreen. Physical cursor check on the user's hardware not performed in this revision.
mediaControlsValidation: Native flyout payload and restart continuity verified with a simulated desktop bridge; the physical Windows flyout and hardware media keys were not exercised.
installations: No personal installation was replaced and nothing was pushed to main.

removedTools: ffprobe (98 MB, never invoked by the app)
removedResources: local dictation models (53 MB, prepared on demand and verified by fingerprint)
installer.localDictation: One path: ffmpeg decodes and the prepared engine transcribes; the fingerprint is checked once per process.

updateFlow: Local check (installer marker and optional channel file), notice in the notification panel, and automatic application: download, SHA-256 verification, silent in-place install and reopening.
musicRestrictions: Restricted catalog songs are resolved online: another public recording of the same song is verified by title, credited artist and duration, and used to save or download it.
fluency: The music position no longer rewrites the whole state every second: it is stored in its own small keys, the heavy save reacts only to real changes, and the local mirror is written on structural changes or every thirty seconds.
playbackFallback: A recording that cannot be played is replaced by another public copy of the same song; if there is none, playback continues with the next song without an interruption notice.
